resources.string: Thumbnails of the title above the progress bar while you seek.
SD and HD titles (480p to 1080p). 4K titles show the time only.
SD, HD and 4K titles. On smaller devices, some 4K thumbnails are made only while paused or after you stop watching.
Make a title\'s seek thumbnails before it starts playing.
Start playing at once; thumbnails are made while paused and after you stop watching.
Make a title\'s seek thumbnails before it starts. \"Start watching now\" or Back starts playback at any time.
On this device, 4K films load after their thumbnails are made.
How many thumbnails are made before a title starts playing. The rest follow while you watch, down to the usual detail.
The whole title covered closely before it starts. The longest wait.
Half as many thumbnails before it starts, spread over the whole title.
A quarter as many before it starts. The shortest wait.
Faster thumbnails made by your box\'s hardware decoder. If thumbnails look wrong or your box struggles, turn this off and they are made the usual way.
They are rebuilt the next time you play a title.
4K on this device: the film loads when this is done
Turn this on or off in Settings › Playback › Player Interface
